title: Git Branches
content: A Git branch allows developers to work on features independently without affecting the main branch.

title: Git Merge
content: Git merge combines changes from one branch into another branch.

title: Model Context Protocol
content: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI models to communicate with external tools through a consistent interface.

title: Pull Request
content: A pull request allows developers to propose changes, review code, and merge updates into another branch.

title: GitHub Issues
content: GitHub Issues are used to track tasks, bugs, feature requests, and project discussions.
